courses.name: UB Curriculum Capstone
courses.description: Builds a reflective portfolio linking general-education coursework with other learning experiences.
courses.prerequisites: Completed UB Seminar; all remaining UB Curriculum requirements completed or concurrently enrolled.

category_review.rationale: The official capstone description is reflective integration of general-education work and lived experience. Portfolio reflection alone does not establish ethics, cultural analysis or a primary taxonomy subject.

requirements.title: Applied capstone
requirements.summary: The program overview identifies a capstone applying program learning to a practical problem; course code and credits are not stated.

requirements.title: University general education scope
requirements.summary: The overview describes40 credits across seminar, foundations, two Pathways and capstone, regardless of major. Transfer students have a different seminar amount; this headline is not summed into an exact AI+X degree total.

requirements.title: Published foundations credit amounts
requirements.summary: Communication Literacy1 is4 credits, CL2 is3, quantitative reasoning is4, and scientific literacy is7. Degree-specific approved choices and transfer substitutions remain unverified.

requirements.title: Entry-semester seminar
requirements.summary: First-year students take a three-credit199 seminar; transfer students take a one-credit198 seminar. All matriculating students must complete the seminar in their first semester, including part-time students.

requirements.title: Seminar and matriculation
requirements.summary: The page states that students unable to take a seminar lose matriculated status and are limited to9 credits per semester as non-degree students. The linked full catalog policy remains unavailable.

requirements.title: Communication Literacy1
requirements.summary: ENG105 is the approved CL1 course. This is a university requirement; approved transfer or other exceptions remain a separate review gap.

requirements.title: Communication Literacy2
requirements.summary: A second writing course develops disciplinary communication; some majors prescribe a particular CL2 course. The AI+X-specific mappings remain unverified.

requirements.title: Scientific literacy and inquiry
requirements.summary: Complete at least two courses totaling at least7 credits, including a laboratory in the same subject as one completed lecture. The full approved course/sequence pool is not mapped.

requirements.title: Diversity within Pathways
requirements.summary: The Diversity in the United States requirement is fulfilled within Pathways; it is not counted as an additional standalone course here.

requirements.title: Two Pathways
requirements.summary: Complete Global and Thematic Pathways, each at least9 credits. Global choices are Global Reflections, Language and Culture, or International Experience; the latter may use study abroad alone or with UB courses.

requirements.title: Thematic choice and perspectives
requirements.summary: Choose Environment, Health, Innovation, Justice or Humanity and examine the topic through three disciplinary perspectives. Exact list-combination and area rules require the linked catalog or Path Finder.

requirements.title: Pathway approval record
requirements.summary: Selections must be submitted through Path Finder to appear on the Academic Advising Report. Public offering tables assist planning; dated offerings are not a complete, timeless approved pool.
